scope_note: This records only the publication span of the complete manual series; its physical organization is stated in a separate claim, and the S3 quotation came specifically from Volume I, Part I (1901).
statement: Titchener's Experimental Psychology manual series was published from 1901 to 1905.
statement_zh: Titchener 的《Experimental Psychology》實驗手冊系列出版於 1901 至 1905 年。
